process_nodes.label: CoWoS
process_nodes.note: SPIL says the plant will focus on CoWoS advanced packaging for AI accelerators and high-performance computing chips.

summary: A new SPIL advanced packaging plant in Douliu, Yunlin County, Taiwan, focused on CoWoS packaging for AI accelerators and high-performance computing chips. SPIL said in January 2025 that it was planning the site, and held the groundbreaking on 11 August 2026. Total investment is put at nearly NT$100 billion on a 6-hectare development area, with the first phase expected to open in 2028. It is SPIL's second Yunlin base after its Huwei plant, which began production in 2025.

metrics.note: Described as nearly NT$100 billion in total.
Jobs expected once the first phase opens.

milestones.note: SPIL said planning was under way for a new factory site in Douliu.
